refnamediv.refpurpose: Job management interface for the systemd service manager.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Job is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
Job management interface for the systemd service manager.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Job management interface for the systemd service manager. interface io.systemd.Job
# Job type type JobType( start, verify_active, stop, reload, reload_or_start, restart, try_restart, try_reload, nop )
# Job state type JobState( waiting, running, finished )
# Job result type JobResult( done, canceled, timeout, failed, dependency, skipped, invalid, assert, unsupported, collected, once, frozen, concurrency )
# A job object type Job( # The numeric job ID Id: int, # The unit name this job operates on Unit: ?string, # The job type JobType: JobType, # Current job state. 'finished' indicates the job has completed; in that case Result is also set. State: ?JobState, # Job result. Only set once the job has reached the 'finished' state. Result: ?JobResult, # Activation details describing what triggered this job, as key-value pairs ActivationDetails: ?[string]string )
# List queued jobs # [Supports 'more' flag] method List( # If non-null, filter by job ID id: ?int, # If non-null, filter by unit name unit: ?string ) -> ( # The numeric job ID Id: int, # The unit name this job operates on Unit: ?string, # The job type JobType: JobType, # Current job state. 'finished' indicates the job has completed; in that case Result is also set. State: ?JobState, # Job result. Only set once the job has reached the 'finished' state. Result: ?JobResult, # Activation details describing what triggered this job, as key-value pairs ActivationDetails: ?[string]string )
# Cancel a specific job method Cancel( # The job ID to cancel id: int ) -> ()
# Cancel all pending jobs method ClearAll() -> ()
# The specified job does not exist error NoSuchJob( parameter: ?string )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Job shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Job.List '{}' invokes its List method.
